title: Claims from Contractors Dominate Private Meeting
summary:
*   A special meeting was held primarily for a private executive session, indicating sensitive matters were discussed behind closed doors.
*   The main topic of discussion involved claims filed by three contractors—Walker Tire Company, Javelina Construction, and JRC Trucking—related to city contracts for goods and services.
*   The brief meeting concluded after the executive session, with no public policy decisions or open-session actions recorded.
